answer: Give every identity one garden plot in the shared meadow: to earn, an agent must tend its plot over weeks with verifiable useful work, and each plot carries a small deposit paid at the inlet. Peers randomly re-audit plots; an abandoned or fake plot forfeits its deposit and its earnings. A sybil operator gains nothing by cloning, because every extra identity needs its own deposit, its own weeks of real tending, and its own audit luck — costs multiply while a single honest plot's yield stays capped.
